info.title: FEAGI API
info.description: FEAGI (Flexible Extensible Artificial General Intelligence) REST API

get.description:
Get all cortical areas.

Returns a list of all cortical areas in the current brain.

post.description:
Create a new cortical area.

Args:
    area: Details of the cortical area to create.

Returns:
    Information about the newly created cortical area.

get.description:
Get a specific cortical area by ID.

Args:
    area_id: String representation of the cortical_idx.

Returns:
    Detailed information about the specified cortical area.

put.description:
Update an existing cortical area.

Args:
    area_id: String representation of the cortical_idx to update.
    area: Updated cortical area details.

Returns:
    The updated cortical area information.

schema.description: String representation of the cortical_idx to update

This API allows you to browse files from your computer and upload a genome to FEAGI.
The genome must be in the form of a JSON file.

Stimulate a cortical area with custom data.

This endpoint allows for sending custom-formatted data directly to a cortical area.
The structure of the input data is determined by the requirements of the specific cortical area.

    input_data: Custom-structured data for stimulation.
